thread:
anya: Quick design check-in: thinking about changing the heatmap binning from uniform buckets to workload-driven buckets (denser bins where latency spikes). Thoughts on how sampling controls should behave with adaptive bins?
sam: sounds useful to surface hotspots. Concern: if bins change size, the sampler percentages become confusing (10% of what?).
matt: proposal: sampler should always be percentage of total traces in view. For adaptive bins, when user picks a bucket we show "X traces (Y% of view)" in tooltip. keeps math consistent.
leo: a11y nit: whatever we show must be announced via a live region when bucket focus changes. For adaptive labels, read "bucket 3 of 6: 120 traces, 8% of view". also ensure keyboard cycles in logical order.
aria: color/accessibility: adaptive bins may create visually tiny buckets. we should add an expanded hover target (non-visible padding) and high-contrast stroke on focus. Also add an alternate high-contrast palette toggle in settings for low-vision users.
katie: copy: instead of "Sampling" maybe use "Trace sample" with subtitle "Shows a subset of traces for clarity". Tooltip when bucket selected: "Showing 12 of 150 traces (8%) from this time range" 14 is that OK?
san: typo: "sam" not "san". sam: ha :) agree with wording but shorten: "Showing 12 of 150 traces (8% of view)". keep it snappy.
matt: UX detail: when bins are adaptive and the sampler is at e.g. 10%, the actual number per bucket will vary; UI can show per-bucket estimated counts and a small badge for "approx". on drag release, recalc exact numbers and update counts.
leo: keyboard mapping: focus on heatmap, press space/enter to open bucket listbox; arrow keys to move buckets; when sampler focused use left/right for 1% nudge, shift+arrow 5%, home/end min/max. announce only on release or >5% change to avoid spam.
aria: for screen reader users, expose a control labelled "Bucket summary" that reads total buckets and lets user request details for the currently selected bucket. avoids 20+ live announcements.
anya: we should also consider a compact density mode: toggles between "Density view" (color intensity) and "Count view" (numeric overlay). default to density. will help in dense charts.
katie: microcopy for the toggle: "Density vs counts" is ambiguous. suggest "Show counts" (off/on) with tooltip "Overlay numeric counts on heatmap buckets".
matt: developer note: add component variant `heatmap--adaptive` + `heatmap--compact-counts`. Need tokens for stroke/focus, invisible hit padding, aria-live region id, and a11y palette.
benji-bot: preview build: https://staging.redwood.ai/heatmap-adaptive-sampler (expires in 48h)
anya: next steps: matt to drop updated mocks + tokens; leo/aria to run quick keyboard/SR pass; katie to finalize copy. we'll do a 5-min lab after preview. thanks :thumbsup:
